identity.kind: manual hydraulic pallet jack (2.5 ton claimed)

claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack.
claims.evidence: photo 0 does not show a readable capacity rating/plate or model/brand marking.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 2.5 ton (or the rating plate may be missing/incorrect).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the capacity rating plate/label (showing the number and unit) and any serial/model plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed capacity (worst case: treat as lower/unknown capacity).

risks.risk: Hydraulics may be weak (won’t lift fully, leaks, or won’t hold load).
risks.proof: A short video: pump to max height, hold for 30–60 seconds with a visible weight/load, then lower smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/needs service (worst case: treat as requiring repair).

risks.risk: Forks/wheels may be worn or damaged (uneven lift, rough movement, bent forks).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both fork tips and edges, plus wheel/caster condition (front rollers and rear wheels).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst case: assume parts may need replacement).

risks.risk: Missing parts or incorrect operation (release lever, pump handle, safety/locking).
risks.proof: Photo of the full handle/pump mechanism and release lever, plus a quick operation clip showing raising and lowering.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/needs checking (worst case: assume missing/needs adjustment).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the capacity rating plate/label (must clearly show “2.5 ton” or equivalent).
Video test: pump to full height, hold for 30–60 seconds (no visible drop), then lower.
Close-up photos of fork tips/edges and both wheel sets (rollers/casters) showing wear or damage.
Photo of the hydraulic pump/release valve area and the full handle mechanism.
response.reason: The photo shows a manual hydraulic pallet jack, but the key details that determine price (capacity rating and hydraulic condition) are not readable or testable from the single image.
